name: Omarchy Snowball Plugin
author: tb
description: Omarchy bar widget for the Snowball auto trader: live Coinbase balances over SSH, health, portfolio chart, and docker restart.

barWidget.description: Omarchy Snowball Plugin — live trader status on the bar.

schema.label: Status URL
schema.description: Snowball dashboard origin, without a trailing path.

schema.label: Health check (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar asks /health. This is the cheap check.

schema.label: Detail check (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar refreshes live Coinbase balances over SSH (plus a short optional /api/snapshot flag poll). 0 skips detail. The Coinbase read can take up to about a minute.

schema.label: Stale tick (seconds)
schema.description: Warn when the last trading tick is older than this.

schema.label: Show day PnL in the bar
Restart SSH user
schema.description: Account on the trader host used by the restart button.

schema.label: Container
schema.description: Docker container the restart button restarts.
